text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, Shinko Windy's race<n>schedule has finally
begun to calm<n>down...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, lackey! So, when're we goin'?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring ticket from the raffle!<n>You didn't lose
it, didja?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd completely forgotten. She's right,<n>though. I did
say we'd go once time<n>opened up in her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one all excited by<n>their big baths,
good food, and comfy<n>futons?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Get your bags packed, then.<n>We're hittin'
the road ASAP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Shinko Windy and I<n>set out on our
much-anticipated hot<n>spring getaway!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa! This place is like a demon<n>lord's
palace...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to enjoy the baths and<n>food! ♪ Time to
live it up, lackey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... I'm all toasty...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The food was top-notch, and the<n>dessert just kept
on comin'... It really<n>doesn't get any better than
this! ♪
choice_data_list: Want to head back to our rooms?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nah... I'mma hang out in yours,<n>lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We're havin' a pillow fight! I'mma<n>bring all the
ones I got from my room!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mwahahaha! Shishimai Attack!Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Followed byyyy... Pillow Ninja Star<n>Onslaught!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fierce and lawless pillow war<n>ensues.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAAAHAHAHA! Windy wins!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gut feeling! I'm pretty sure I hit you<n>more than you
hit me! And we're not<n>done just yet!
choice_data_list: (I'll play along until she's had her fill...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But even after the pillow fight ends,<n>she just lazes
around in my room,<n>teetering on the edge of deep
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmph... Wha?! Oh, it's my drool...<n>Ahaha...
choice_data_list: We should call it a night...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Buuuut... I don't wanna...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Lackey.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I decided I'm sleepin' here tonight.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Buuut why nooot?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! You can't make me<n>gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrr... I'm not budging!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: 'Cause... There's nobody else in my<n>room.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's too big for one person. I'll get<n>antsy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Here's the thing. Back at my dorm, I<n>can't catch
any Z's unless my<n>roommate's there!
choice_data_list:
Actually, I do feel like you've mentioned that
before...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You really gonna force me to stay up<n>all night?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Some trainer you are. Couldn't care<n>less if your
trainee gets sick, huh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Regardless, it's inappropriate for me<n>to let her stay.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: One, two... Trainer, you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I convince her to go back to her room<n>by offering to
stay connected via<n>video chat through our phones.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yup... I got the lights off and my phone<n>propped up
next to my pillow.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Just gotta get under the covers. Hold<n>on a sec...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A "remote sleepover." This way, she<n>won't feel
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"There... All good. You awake,<n>Trainer? Tell me a
funny story."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly make out anything on my<n>screen
besides Windy's sleepy face<n>dimly illuminated by
her phone.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "...Hehe. That was boring..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "But... tell me... more..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't go to sleep... either... Keep your<n>eyes... fixed
on me... And...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Stay... by... my side...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Zzz... zzz... Mnnngh..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Shinko Windy and I have<n>formed an
irreplaceable bond during<n>this time together.
